title: Four-level page tables
description:
Translate a 48-bit virtual address through four levels of page tables.

```
VA 0x00007FF6A1C34123
  PML4 index 255, PDPT 474, PD 270, PT 52, offset 0x123
  walk: present, present, present, present -> physical 0x1A2B3123
VA 0x0000000000001000 -> PT entry not present -> page fault
```
requirements: Split the address: four 9-bit indexes and a 12-bit offset.
Tables are `std::map<int, ...>` levels ending in frame numbers; a missing entry is a fault.
Print each step of the walk.
stretch: Add a small TLB that remembers the last 4 translations and count hits.
